_description: Shared heuristic reference database. Used by convert.py for baseline ref lookup. Same data as evidence-info/official-urls.md but in machine-readable JSON.

1.name: Nielsen #1 — Visibility of System Status
1.quote: The design should always keep users informed about what is going on, through appropriate feedback within a reasonable amount of time.

2.name: Nielsen #2 — Match Between System and Real World
2.quote: The design should speak the users' language. Use words, phrases, and concepts familiar to the user.

3.name: Nielsen #3 — User Control and Freedom
3.quote: Users often perform actions by mistake. They need a clearly marked 'emergency exit' to leave the unwanted action.

4.name: Nielsen #4 — Consistency and Standards
4.quote: Users should not have to wonder whether different words, situations, or actions mean the same thing.

5.name: Nielsen #5 — Error Prevention
5.quote: Good error messages are important, but the best designs carefully prevent problems from occurring in the first place.

6.name: Nielsen #6 — Recognition Rather Than Recall
6.quote: Minimize the user's memory load by making elements, actions, and options visible.

7.name: Nielsen #7 — Flexibility and Efficiency of Use
7.quote: Shortcuts — hidden from novice users — may speed up the interaction for the expert user.

8.name: Nielsen #8 — Aesthetic and Minimalist Design
8.quote: Interfaces should not contain information that is irrelevant or rarely needed.

9.name: Nielsen #9 — Help Users Recognize, Diagnose, and Recover from Errors
9.quote: Error messages should be expressed in plain language, precisely indicate the problem, and constructively suggest a solution.

10.name: Nielsen #10 — Help and Documentation
10.quote: It's best if the system doesn't need any additional explanation. However, it may be necessary to provide documentation.

3.3.4.name: WCAG 3.3.4 — Error Prevention: Legal, Financial, Data (Level AA)

fitts.name: Fitts's Law
fitts.quote: The time to acquire a target is a function of the distance to and size of the target.

hick.name: Hick's Law
hick.quote: The time it takes to make a decision increases with the number and complexity of choices.

jakob.name: Jakob's Law
jakob.quote: Users spend most of their time on other sites. This means that users prefer your site to work the same way.

miller.name: Miller's Law
miller.quote: The average person can only keep 7 (plus or minus 2) items in their working memory.

peak_end.name: Peak-End Rule
peak_end.quote: People judge an experience largely based on how they felt at its most intense point and at its end.

zeigarnik.name: Zeigarnik Effect
zeigarnik.quote: People remember uncompleted or interrupted tasks better than completed tasks.

von_restorff.name: Von Restorff Effect
von_restorff.quote: When multiple similar objects are present, the one that differs from the rest is most likely to be remembered.

doherty.name: Doherty Threshold
doherty.quote: Productivity soars when a computer and its users interact at a pace (<400ms) that ensures that neither has to wait on the other.

aesthetic_usability.name: Aesthetic-Usability Effect
aesthetic_usability.quote: Users often perceive aesthetically pleasing design as design that's more usable.
